bead.title: claude-tui/step1: extract internal/harnesses/anthropic/ neutral shared-helper package
bead.description:
Plan step 1. Provide a neutral package both harnesses depend on without creating a claude <-> claude-tui import edge. The harness interface refactor unexported the per-harness snapshot types; anthropic/ holds the shared shapes claude-tui needs to consume the same underlying quota cache.

MOVES (from internal/harnesses/claude/ to internal/harnesses/anthropic/):
- IsClaudeQuotaExhaustedMessage + MarkClaudeQuotaExhaustedFromMessage + quota-message corpus -> anthropic/quota_messages.go.
- AccountInfo plan-classification helpers (if any are claude-specific; likely none).
- Model-name normalization helpers shared with the catalog -> anthropic/models.go.
- A neutral snapshot mirror struct (sufficient for claude-tui's QuotaHarness.QuotaStatus to project) -> anthropic/quota_snapshot.go.

Updates internal/harnesses/claude/ imports to consume from anthropic/. Existing claude tests must continue to pass with no behavior change.
bead.acceptance:
1) internal/harnesses/anthropic/ exists with quota_messages.go, models.go (if any moves), and quota_snapshot.go.
2) internal/harnesses/claude/ no longer owns the moved symbols; it imports from anthropic. The claude harness package compiles without claude-tui present.
3) internal/harnesses/anthropic/ itself does NOT import internal/harnesses/claude, internal/harnesses/claude-tui, or any other harness package. Cycle prevention verified by a goimports/list test.
4) No new public surface beyond the four CONTRACT-004 interfaces appears outside the anthropic package; the harnessimports lint rule passes.
5) Regression guard: every existing test under internal/harnesses/claude/ stays green with no behavior change (assertion: same test names pass with identical outputs).
6) Table tests for the quota-message corpus moved into anthropic/quota_messages_test.go: classifier identifies known-exhausted-message strings and rejects negative cases.
7) go test ./internal/harnesses/... -count=1 green; go test ./... -count=1 green; lefthook run pre-commit green.
